source_text.diagnosis: scripts/test_parallel.sh killed the per-partition watchdog subshell by pid only; its sleep child survived holding the stdout pipe (reader stalls up to 1800 s). Fix: kill the watchdog's process group at the Step 3 site and in the EXIT trap.

task.description: Validate test/scripts/test_parallel_watchdog_orphan_test.exs with mutation testing against scripts/test_parallel.sh. Mutants: M1 revert the fix at the Step 3 post-wait site only (kill subshell pid only) -> a test must fail; M2 revert at the EXIT-trap site only -> a test must fail; M3 remove the watchdog TERM/KILL of the hung partition (e.g. delete the kill -TERM line) -> the hung-partition test must fail; M4 make the script exit 0 when a partition fails (e.g. final exit 0) -> the failing-partition test must fail.
acceptance_criteria: Each of M1-M4 reported killed or survived with the failing test name quoted
git diff empty (scripts/ and test/) and HEAD unchanged after each mutant; restore from a backup copy outside the repo, never git checkout of uncommitted work
Verdict on coverage of: success path, failing partition, EXIT-trap path, hung partition
